entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • F12 no longer takes me to my class file when used on a Form #78898
    Backlog
  • IDE0052 not displaying when collection expression is used in class #78893
    Backlog
  • Pragma warnings IDE0028, IDE0305, IDE0301 to prefer collection expressions should not pop up when current editor target is less net9 #78892
  • BuildHost crash due to gaps in the solution directory #78889

Closed

  • SymbolKeyTestBase.ResolveAndVerifySymbol ignores 'newCompilation' input parameter #45894
    Backlog
  • RemoteControlClient doesn't support BehaviorOnStale.ReturnStale on NetCore. #71014
    Backlog
  • CodeLensCallbackListener.GetDocumentIdAndNodeAsync may throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException #44639
    Backlog
  • Lost ability to suppress CA warnings in Microsoft Visual Studio Enterprise 2022 (64-bit) - Current Version 17.10.0 #73838
    Backlog
  • TestGetFixesWithDeprioritizedAnalyzerAsync tests a scenario that cannot be reached #77036
  • Many CodeFixProvider such as CSharpAddImportCodeFixProvider does not work on WASM #78079
  • API Proposal: Allow creating custom Workspace classes #76433
  • Goto definition is not working for some (all?) external references. #78896
  • Use primary constructor (IDE0290) ignores side effects #78897
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10709.26 #78884
